# Introduction

This is a basic Quarto document demonstrating fundamental features.

## Code Execution

### Python Code

```{python}
#| label: fig-basic-plot
#| fig-cap: "Basic Python Plot"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

x = np.linspace(0, 10, 100)
y = np.sin(x)

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.plot(x, y)
plt.title("Sine Wave")
plt.xlabel("X values")
plt.ylabel("Y values")
plt.show()
```

### Inline Code

The result of `{python} 2 + 2` is calculated inline.

### R Code

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-plot
#| fig-cap: "Basic R Plot"
library(ggplot2)

data <- data.frame(
  x = 1:10,
  y = (1:10)^2
)

ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Quadratic Function",
       x = "X values",
       y = "Y values")
```
